shots.visual: A massive fire burns at the Jingzhou docks, reflecting on the dark river water.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 荊州碼頭火光沖天，敵襲！

shots.visual: Close-up of eyes reflecting the orange flames, brow furrowed in intense focus.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孫權，你想用淹城換我主力？

shots.visual: One character points at a map while the other stands firm, both illuminated by fire.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，水閘已被細作破壞！

shots.visual: A cold, decisive look replaces the initial shock.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 水患已緩，他必急搶糧草。

shots.visual: The protagonist draws a sword and points it toward the river bank.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳令，口袋陣合圍，斷其後路！

shots.visual: Dozens of small warships stealthily approach the burning dock through the mist.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 東吳水師，正落入致命陷阱。

shots.visual: Soldiers on the ship are cheering, holding torches and ready to jump ashore.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 攻破碼頭，荊州糧草盡歸東吳！

shots.visual: A slight, mocking smile appears on the protagonist's face.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 想要糧？我送你滿船烈火！

shots.visual: The strategist signals with a feather fan toward the sky.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 放箭！焚江！

shots.visual: Thousands of fire arrows rain down from the dark hills onto the river.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 漫天箭雨，封死退路。

shots.visual: The smile on the villain's face freezes into a look of pure terror.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 不好！劉備早有預判！

shots.visual: The deck catches fire instantly, soldiers are falling into the water in chaos.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 快撤！快撤回江心！

shots.visual: Looking down from the cliff at the burning fleet below.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，東吳敗局已定。

shots.visual: The protagonist stares intently at one specific, larger ship.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 不對，旗艦上那是誰？

shots.visual: A massive flagship, untouched by the initial fire, slowly turns its side.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 煙塵中，一人負手而立。

shots.visual: The villain stands on the burning bow, his face illuminated by a sinister green fire.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備，你以為贏了嗎？

shots.visual: The protagonist's expression shifts from triumph to confusion.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這狂笑……他在打什麼主意？

shots.visual: The villain throws a set of heavy keys into the river with a wild look.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 鑰匙已毀，水閘將永世閉鎖！

shots.visual: The strategist drops his fan in shock.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 不好！水閘失控，洪水倒灌！

shots.visual: The villain laughs maniacally while his own ship starts to tilt.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 陪我東吳水師，一起死吧！

shots.visual: A giant wave of water starts to crest behind the protagonist, towering over the docks.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 瘋子……他竟然要同歸於盡！
